title: Sources: QB Willis, Fins reach 3-year, $67.5M deal

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Sources: QB Willis, Fins reach 3-year, $67.5M deal
sources.description: Free agent QB Malik Willis, after reviving his career with the Packers, has agreed to a three-year, $67.5 million deal with the Dolphins, sources told ESPN.
